provenance_note: LULC observations are retrieved from ISRO/NRSC Bhuvan LULC 50K 2015-16 state-specific layers through WMS GetFeatureInfo. Background samples use the state already attached by the BhooPehra negative sampler. No state is guessed from a bounding box.
background_label_definition: Records beginning with NEG- or GSI_BACKGROUND_, or explicitly labelled label=0 / BACKGROUND_CANDIDATE, are treated as background records.
